description: Header file defining hardware semaphore constants, macros, and inline functions for STM32 microcontrollers within Zephyr RTOS, specifically for STM32WBX, STM32H7, and STM32MP1 series.

methods.name: z_stm32_hsem_lock
methods.description: Locks a hardware semaphore with retry mechanism, panics if lock cannot be acquired within retries.

methods.name: z_stm32_hsem_try_lock
methods.description: Attempts to lock a hardware semaphore, returns -EAGAIN if unsuccessful.

methods.name: z_stm32_hsem_is_owned
methods.description: Checks if the current core owns the specified hardware semaphore.
